summary: All 8 first-pass findings confirmed at their original severities (1 blocker, 3 major, 4 minor); none refuted, none uncertain, no missed defects found (deps exec cleanly, all header/call arities match, target magnitudes are well above atol). The problem is fixable to fair entirely with cheap text edits: 66.6's blocker and D10 are pure prompt/doc edits (state per-atom normalization; remove the stale corrupted parameter block), 66.1 and 66.2 need the construction/ordering and zero-cross/cyclic-pairing conventions written into the prompts, and the one-sided assert in 66.6 tests 3-5 is a one-character parenthesization fix that provably does not disturb correct solutions. Only the two minor D8 test-strength gaps (flat-geometry normals, untested taper cutoff) would require adding new targets to the h5, and they are optional hardening rather than fairness requirements.
